reason: Upstream falls back to memory.md whenever the server is unavailable. In this standard memory.md is a project-seed for verified, global, stable, non-derivable facts (S.5.2), so an unreachable server would quietly harden ordinary working context into long-term memory. The fallback routes to the canonical owner instead; the criteria of memory.md are not relaxed because a server is down.

replacements.find: (fallback: `memory.md → Captured during work` when the server is unavailable)
replacements.replace: (fallback when the server is unavailable: route the fact to its canonical owner — `DEFECTS.md`, `PLAYBOOK.md`, `USER-RULES.md`, `LLM-RULES.md` or the profile document; `memory.md` only if the fact meets its own criteria)
